headline: Stonecradle and Weathered Expanse Roar; Stlican Shelf Stirs
war_summary: Since the last edition, Stonecradle has flared to the fore, clocking nine changes of strategic-base ownership in the latest two hours against three in the previous span. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest front, with ten changes in two hours and sixty-eight on the day. Stlican Shelf, quiet at the last report, has stirred again with three changes in two hours and eight in six. Linn Mercy keeps swinging with two fresh changes and a day tally of eighteen; Godcrofts and Fisherman's Row likewise logged two apiece in the latest two-hour ledger. Farranac Coast and Viper Pit, active at last report, have produced no fresh change in that recent window. Callahan's Passage still shows heavy casualties yet has had no change of base ownership since late morning. Casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating across the active fronts. No faction yet commands the thirty-four victory towns required, and a victor remains undecided.
